description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of tests for the 'git check-ignore' command and its related functionalities. It includes functions to simulate various scenarios, setup test environments, and verify behavior with different options such as --stdin, --quiet, --verbose, and handling of symlinks and submodules.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes environment variables related to ignore files.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Enables global ignore file by setting core.excludesfile in git config.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Stores expected output in a destination file for comparison.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Wrapper to store expected stdout output.

methods.name: expect_from_stdin
methods.description: Stores expected output from stdin input.

methods.name: test_stderr
methods.description: Checks for specific content in stderr output.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Verifies that stderr contains a given regular expression.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Checks if stderr is empty or contains expected content based on expected exit code.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Main test procedure invoking git check-ignore with given arguments and verifying results.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multiple
methods.description: Runs multiple variations of a test with different verbosity and index/no-index options.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multi
methods.description: Wrapper to run tests with '--index' argument.

methods.name: test_expect_success_no_index_multi
methods.description: Wrapper to run tests with '--no-index' argument.
